title: Valmiki Ramayana
attributionNote: Valmiki Ramayana, as Heritage IITKanpur's Scripture Server catalogues it (VRAM), on its own shelf.
description:
The Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa is the ancient Sanskrit epic (ādi-kāvya) traditionally ascribed to the sage Vālmīki — about 24,000 verses across seven Kāṇḍas: Bāla, Ayodhyā, Araṇya, Kiṣkindhā, Sundara, Yuddha and Uttara. Each Kāṇḍa is divided into Sargas (cantos) and each Sarga into ślokas (verses).

This edition follows the Southern recension and reproduces the digital edition prepared by Rashtriya Sanskrita Vidyapeetham, Tirupati (hosted at valmiki.iitk.ac.in and rsvpramayana.in): the word-order meaning and English translation of every verse, a contemporary-English summary of each Sarga, and six selected classical Sanskrit commentaries together with their English translations. The summary above is the one Heritage IITKanpur's Scripture Server publishes for the text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Heritage Scripture Server corpus, which continues the Gita Supersite built at IIT Kanpur: the text, its classical commentaries and the translations the server may serve are held together there.
availabilityNote: The outline is held: 533 chapter(s) and 18996 verse address(es), read from the server's own catalogue. The verses are not stored — the licence forbids bulk harvesting and database reconstruction — and are streamed from the API one verse at a time as the work is read, with the attribution HCAL-1.1 requires and the server's own quota and licence notice.

editions.rightsStatus: Tier A (the moolam and its transliterations): no modern copyright, freely redistributable. Where the API serves Tier B — the Sanskrit bhāṣya and the AI-generated, community and editorially authored translations — it is displayed non-commercially with attribution and is not relicensed here. Tier C, the authoritative modern-language translations and commentaries, is not served by the API and is not imported.
